hints.title: Modulo Three Equivalence Classes
hints.text: Only stone values modulo three affect the sum. Categorize elements into count of zeros, ones, and twos.

hints.title: Impact of Modulo Zero Stones
hints.text: Zeros can be played at any legal turn without altering the modulo state, effectively flipping player parity.

hints.title: Parity Case Analysis
hints.text: If count of zeros is even, Alice wins if both ones and twos are present. If count of zeros is odd, Alice wins if absolute difference between ones and twos exceeds two.
